period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the Half Yearly ended June 2017 (Unaudited)"), used as the Q2 data point. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2017' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2017') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 237,881.02m + Total equity 27,997.82m = Total assets 265,878.83m exactly; Profit before tax (2,459.65m) - Tax (812.97m) = Net profit after tax (1,646.68m) exactly. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. NOTE: this filing's Dec-2016 Solo comparative total assets (259,423.95m) and Consolidated comparative (259,402.33m) both disagree with the dataset's existing 2016_Q4 stored total_assets of 254,776m -- the same pattern of discrepancy already flagged for 2015_Q4 in 2015_Q3.json / 2016_Q1.json, suggesting a systematic issue in the existing Q4 series (sourced from the FY2019 annual report's 5-year summary table) rather than an isolated error. Flagged for review, not corrected here.
